changes: Close payroll into Salary History before journaling, with a separate Post to Active Journal action. Save journal template is now clearly labelled.
Edit closed payroll with the saved calculation rules. Open-month corrections keep their journal ID; closed-month corrections retain the original and require a separate adjustment and explanation.
Centered report titles, short centered signature lines, editable names and job titles below each line, and saved report defaults.
Payroll rate, source, date, month and reference appear above the breakdown. Rates use the compact format ₭22,912/$.
The editor Print button is compact, leaving room for the adjacent formatting, voucher and receipt controls.
